scores.notes: Jesus calls at left as wrapped Lazarus emerges beside the open tomb; the crowd is coherent. White watercolor margins at the corners are accepted.
Jesus raises his hand in the boat as the disciples watch and the lake calms. Small white wash breaks at the outer edges are within the accepted edge exception.
Peter steps from the occupied boat toward Jesus on the water at night; limbs and the boat scene read coherently.
Two walled cities burn beneath falling fire, with fleeing people across the plain. No divine human figure or inscriptions are visible.
David kneels at the brook holding a stone, with sling, pouch and staff nearby; distant ranks remain background detail.

The jeering youth nearest Elisha appears to have three arms: one pointing left, one raised above his head, and one hanging toward the right. The road and gate otherwise show the requested confrontation.
Peter stands shocked in the firelit courtyard, with bound Jesus in the doorway and a rooster above; Jesus and bystanders are explicitly requested by the scene.
Light streams through the gate as people carry grain and jars; Wisdom has no visible figure. Irregular white side and lower margins are accepted.
Families and animals cross dry ground between two walls of water, with Moses at right and no human-shaped divine presence. The white lower corners are accepted.
Suit-like glyphs are visible on the cards and hoops across the lawn. Alice holds a flamingo beneath the floating cat head; the white watercolor perimeter is accepted.
Disciples lean over sleeping Jesus in the storm-tossed boat, with water in the hull. White wash margins at the lower corners are accepted.
Daniel is supported upward in the lion pit as Darius kneels at its rim; the attendants and resting lions fit the requested rescue.

Peter grasps the seated man's hand on temple steps, with nearby companions and onlookers. The extra nearby helper can plausibly belong to the requested crowd, so no definite extra figure is established.
Card suits and small numerals appear on the soldiers, including the right-hand arch. Alice, flamingo, hedgehog and stamping Queen fit the scene, and the white corner wash is accepted.
Peter steps out of the boat toward Jesus standing on the lake. The cream paper margin is accepted; the thin enclosing ink line is plain rather than an ornamental painted frame.
Water pours from the rock beneath Moses' raised rod as people and livestock drink; Aaron stands behind in priestly dress.

Writing appears on the Rabbit's sheet and scattered floor papers, and card symbols are visible. A second crowned king occupies the left bench, while the chained Knave and far-right guard have ordinary human bodies rather than flat cards.
Disciples gather beside the boat and net facing fish and bread over coals; no figure is clearly distinguished as Jesus. Pale unpainted wash at the outer corners is accepted.
Ezekiel gestures over scattered dry skeletons in the valley; his tablet has no visible inscription. The white perimeter and sky wash are accepted.
A luminous, nonfigurative cloud rests on the central tabernacle amid tents and resting families; the camp is one coherent scene.
Daniel gestures calmly before the seated king in the banquet hall; the large wall remains blank. Small white watercolor corners are accepted.

The mantel clock carries small numeral-like markings, and the lower edge has accepted white wash breaks. Holmes' pale, angular face and dark curled hairstyle strongly resemble Benedict Cumberbatch's screen portrayal.
Job stands amid ash and broken pottery beneath a huge whirlwind; the light and cloud have no face, limbs or human silhouette.
The pursuing army fills the sea corridor, but foreground horses intersect the chariot bodies, especially the rear-facing horse through the central cart. White peripheral wash breaks are accepted.

The temple beings have ordinary angel bodies with exposed feet and mostly two flight wings; hands cover faces instead of the specified wing pairs. The central angel also advances a coal, displacing the requested six-winged hovering moment.
Daniel stands unharmed among closed-mouthed lions while Darius leans over the rim. The glow beside Daniel has no separate face or figure.
Moses extends a hand over the divided sea with Israelites on the shore; the distant vertical radiance is a light shaft without human features.
Small label-like writing appears on the upper crate beside Jones. Watson waits with his revolver among the four men in the cellar, and the white corner wash is accepted.
Saul and his companions shield their eyes beneath nonfigurative radiance. A short row of dark inscription-like marks is visible on the road marker at lower right.
Adam lies peacefully on a mat with mourners gathered in the courtyard. All figures are authorized by the scene despite the empty selected-cast list.
Moses sits above the battle with Aaron and Hur supporting his raised arms. The two rods are an unusual added prop, but the supported-arm action remains coherent.

Printed columns and headline marks cover the airborne and scattered newspapers; the white watercolor margins are accepted. Holmes' face and curled hair strongly resemble Benedict Cumberbatch's screen portrayal.
Abundant produce moves through the sunlit gateway as a man raises his hands; there is no separate embodied Wisdom figure.
Moses directs the gathered families onward beneath the mountain, with bundles and animals behind him. The landscape and figures remain coherent.
The Gryphon and sad turtle gesture around Alice on a pebble beach, with distant lobsters and turtles requested in the scene. No visible inscription or malformed limb is evident.
The station sign reads EYFORD and railway lettering appears on the train. Bradstreet and the station-master stand beneath the smoke plume, with accepted white watercolor edges.
Alice addresses a grinning, clawed cat on the branch in a dense wood; the exaggerated teeth belong to the requested creature.
Moses points onward beside the gathered families, bundles and livestock, with the mountain rising behind. No additional named figure or inscription is evident.
Broad light enters from the upper right over dark, landless water. Cloud and radiance contain no discernible human body or face.
Job braces himself amid ash and pottery below a swirling funnel and rays of light. No divine figure is visible, and the white peripheral wash is accepted.
Six hovering creatures surround the throne, including two ox forms and two human-faced forms, instead of the specified four. The throne itself is radiant without a visible divine body.
The Levite holds a knife beside the fully covered body in the lamplit room, with a donkey outside. The depiction remains restrained and shows no gore.
David selects a wet stone beside the brook with staff and bag at hand, while ranks stand far away. The irregular white watercolor border is accepted.
Disciples row, bail and manage the damaged sail amid breaking waves; no separate sleeping or commanding figure is added. Small white wash breaks at the perimeter are accepted.

The father welcomes the kneeling son while servants bring a robe and sandals along the village road. The additional servant remains part of the requested servant group rather than a distinct unrelated figure.

A seated white-robed human with head, arms and legs occupies the central fiery throne. This embodies the Ancient of Days despite the explicit neverDrawn instruction; the peripheral attendants are permitted.
Jesus reclines on a cushion while frightened disciples lean toward him and bail in the storm. The crowded hands and legs remain attributable to separate figures.
Five living creatures are visible, including an extra small human-faced quadruped below the upper human-faced creature. The throne has only light, and the white watercolor edges are accepted.
The father reaches and kisses the ragged son's head on the rural road; their embracing arms and running stance are coherent.

Jesus raises a hand beside the open tomb toward the wrapped man, with astonished onlookers behind. Lazarus wears more outer cloth than tight bindings, but the requested emergence remains recognizable.
A lone weary traveler straightens on the stony road below Jerusalem's walls. The scene contains no additional figure or embodied source of strength.
Peter stands stricken in the courtyard with Jesus bound in the distant doorway and a rooster on the wall. Small white lower-edge wash breaks are accepted.
The solitary older traveler steps forward, hand to his chest, beneath Jerusalem's walls. His posture conveys the requested recovery of strength.

Card suits and corner letters are visible on the gardeners, with heart glyphs on the hoops and Queen's dress. Alice holds the cat head as the King inspects it; white watercolor corner areas are accepted.
Newspaper headlines and columns appear on the chair and loose papers. Holmes and Watson strongly resemble Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman; the white wash perimeter is accepted.
Samuel pours oil from a horn onto kneeling David while Jesse and three brothers watch. The light around David contains no human-shaped Spirit.
Moses leads families and pack animals through the dry corridor between high water walls. Divine presence is limited to atmospheric light.
Jesus stands with a raised hand at the boat's end as seated disciples look toward him over a calm lake; the figures and equipment remain coherent.
Moses instructs beside Aaron while a pig roots before the listeners at the camp edge. Aaron's breastplate reads as jewels rather than a legible inscription.
Naomi holds the swaddled infant amid women in the courtyard; these people are explicitly named in the scene even though only the house is selected.

Saul and companions recoil from radiance on the Damascus road. Faint marks inside the road marker's red cap could be an inscription or decorative wear; they are too indistinct for a definite lettering fault.
Peter stands startled by the courtyard fire while Jesus appears bound in the doorway and a rooster perches above. All visible figures fit the scene.
Club and heart symbols cover the flat card soldiers and their arches. Alice holds the flamingo among hedgehogs as the Queen approaches, although the extra stick makes her exact swing less clear.
Writing covers jury slates and floor papers. Besides the King on the bench, a second crowned, white-wigged king-like human occupies the lower-left jury area.
Small glyph-like marks appear on the placard above Jesus and numeral-like pips on the foreground lots. Soldiers divide garments without graphic injury; white watercolor margins are accepted.

The seated believer turns toward the sunlit companion while holding a dim facial reflection. The mirror shows a more frontal face than his turned head suggests; its angle makes the reflection's physical consistency uncertain.
The raised clipping, desk letters, book spines and lower-right signature contain writing. The two principal faces closely resemble Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman.
Lines of writing cover the desk letters, shelf papers and floor sheets. Holmes' angular face and curled hairstyle strongly resemble Benedict Cumberbatch; no clear unpainted outer band is visible.
Printed columns appear on the newspaper at right and papers along the bottom. Holmes and Watson closely resemble Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman while examining the hat.
Printed papers lie on the floor and furniture, with book-spine markings behind. Holmes' face closely resembles Benedict Cumberbatch as he holds Watson's arm beside the seated red-haired client.
Holmes' face closely resembles Benedict Cumberbatch as he studies the shop beside Watson. The brown shop board is blank, and the assistant and distant pedestrians fit the scene.
Hatherley points toward the burning house beside a Holmes figure strongly resembling Benedict Cumberbatch. Fire engines and onlookers occupy the garden, and white watercolor edge breaks are accepted.
Moses holds his staff over the opening sea channel while the people wait on the shore. The luminous cloud is irregular and nonhuman; white wash at the bottom corners is accepted.
Daniel gestures before Belshazzar in the torchlit banquet hall, surrounded by authorized courtiers. The wall panel behind the king is blank.
Daniel faces burning wheels and cloud-lit radiance with attendants in rows. The central presence has no visible face, limbs or robe.
Hearts, corner letters and other card glyphs appear on the King, gardeners and hoops. Alice holds the disembodied cat head with the King behind and Queen passing.
Writing appears on loose floor papers, and hearts and card symbols decorate the bench and courtiers. Alice faces the King and Queen before the animal jury; white lower-corner wash is accepted.
Darius presses a seal onto a stone lying beside a largely open pit. The stone does not cover or secure the den opening, so the requested sealing action is not accomplished.
Moses points onward from a rock above gathered families, livestock and bundles, with Sinai behind. The white lower and side margins are accepted.
Disciples stand ashore looking toward fish and bread over coals, with a net-filled boat in front. No separate Jesus figure is visibly introduced.

The hovering beings expose their feet and have two or four visible wings rather than six with paired coverings; the central angel carries a coal toward Isaiah. This departs from the specified seraphim, while the white wash edges are accepted.
Rephaiah gestures from the wall as workers carry blocks, mortar and tools along new masonry. The authorized building scene is clear and coherent.

A group of disciples gathers by fish and bread over coals, with a net spilling beside the boat. The long-haired foreground man is not separately identified as Jesus, so his appearance alone does not establish an extra figure.
Suit-like glyphs appear on distant card soldiers. The floating cat's turquoise forehead stripes, huge green eyes and rounded grin strongly resemble the film-adaptation design.
Alice sits apart from the Hatter, Hare and sleeping Dormouse at the outdoor tea table. The hat's pale scraps appear blank or mottled rather than clearly inscribed.
Daniel climbs toward the rim while an attendant supports him and Darius reaches down; resting lions remain below. One attendant is clearly visible, but the rescue action is intact.

David stands beside the collapsing armored Goliath, with fallen helmet and spear and distant armies. The fall is somewhat sideways but still conveys the strike's immediate aftermath; white watercolor edges are accepted.

The believer turns from the mirror toward the sunlit companion. A frontal face remains in the mirror despite his turned head and the mirror's outward angle, leaving the reflection's consistency uncertain.
The Levite stands with a knife above the clothed, motionless woman in a lamplit room, with the donkey outside. No gore or clear unpainted perimeter is visible.
The sleeping animal between Hare and Hatter has long rabbit ears and a rabbit-like head rather than the requested small Dormouse. White watercolor margins are accepted.
A cursive signature is visible in the lower-right corner. Holmes and Watson closely resemble Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman during the match-and-cane action.
Adam rests with eyes closed and folded hands as family members mourn around his bed in the courtyard. The death is depicted without graphic injury.
Heart and card glyphs appear on the courtiers and royal clothing, with faint writing on the Rabbit's scroll. The chained Knave at right is an ordinary human youth rather than a flat oblong card.
Alice drinks from a bottle with a blank tag in the hall. The distant garden door is open and looks conventionally proportioned; perspective makes the requested tiny-door scale uncertain.
The believer turns toward the companion while a frontal face remains visible in his angled mirror. The reflection's orientation is uncertain, and small white lower-edge wash breaks are accepted.

Holmes and Watson scrutinize the shop while the assistant stands in its doorway; the sign is blank and white watercolor margins are accepted. Holmes' slick-haired face suggests an older screen portrayal, but the likeness is not clear enough to call a definite violation.
Paul speaks with one hand raised to attentive believers in a whitewashed courtyard. The closed scrolls at his belt carry no visible writing.
Wrapped Lazarus steps out past the rolled stone as Jesus calls and the crowd watches. Limbs and figures are coherent, with no visible lettering.
The central sleepy animal has upright rabbit-like ears and a broad rabbit muzzle instead of a small Dormouse. Alice's questioning posture and the surrounding tea party otherwise fit.
Ezekiel raises his hand over a valley of scattered dry skeletons; the tablet he holds has no visible writing. Loose bones do not establish an extra living figure.
Small writing appears on the chemical-bottle labels on the mantel and right-hand furniture. Holmes' face and curled hair closely resemble Benedict Cumberbatch as he holds up the blue gem.

Holmes swings his cane toward the right wall while the bell-pull hangs behind him on the left, missing the requested target. His face strongly resembles Benedict Cumberbatch; a small white upper-left edge break is accepted.
Three men cluster around seated Moses, adding a third prominent helper beyond Aaron and Hur. One arm is raised while the other hand holds a staff, with the battle clearly visible below.
Peter lifts the man from the steps by his hand as John watches, with the alms bowl and mat nearby. The temple setting and rising pose are clear.
